segments.motivation: To efficiently organize, track, and coordinate team projects and workflows.
To manage personal tasks, daily to-dos, and stay organized across various responsibilities.
To keep track of diverse business activities, ideas, and responsibilities in a visual and accessible format.

tasks.purpose: to keep track of responsibilities and stay focused
by adding due dates, attachments, and marking completion

tasks.context: by sharing task information and files
tasks.purpose: to ensure everyone has access to relevant details and context
to streamline processes and reduce manual effort

tasks.context: like Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Jira
tasks.purpose: to centralize communication and task management across tools

benefits.claim: Provides a clear and visual way to organize tasks, ideas, and responsibilities in one place.
Helps users stay efficient and on top of their work by simplifying to-do lists and managing due dates.
Streamlines workflows through automation and seamless integration with other essential business tools.

frictions.claim: May become less effective for very large or highly complex projects requiring detailed dependency tracking or advanced reporting features.
AI features, while useful for text refinement and brainstorming, might not be as deeply integrated or context-aware as those offered by newer, AI-first project management platforms.
Managing a very high volume of cards or boards might lack sufficient hierarchical structure for some users, potentially leading to visual clutter or difficulty in overviewing interconnected work.

unknowns: Detailed performance issues under heavy load.
Specific experiences with customer support responsiveness or quality.
